PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, owner_id, session_id, source_kind, source_id, kind, target_id)

message_ref: CASE WHEN (source_kind = 'message'::text) THEN (source_id)::bigint ELSE NULL::bigint END
turn_ref: CASE WHEN (source_kind = 'turn'::text) THEN source_id ELSE NULL::text END
path_ref: CASE WHEN (kind = 'mastery_path_id'::text) THEN target_id ELSE NULL::text END
workspace_ref: CASE WHEN (kind = 'reading_workspace_id'::text) THEN target_id ELSE NULL::text END
material_ref: CASE WHEN (kind = 'reading_material_id'::text) THEN target_id ELSE NULL::text END
